name: SIS
tagline: Unofficial client for SIS CUNI (Student Information System, Charles University)
blurb: This is a basic Android app, which loads the website of SIS CUNI (using WebView) and injects custom styles and scripts to make the website more mobile- and user-friendly.
description:
